evidence.reason: Git quotes patch pathnames containing a double-quote character even when core.quotePath=false. The changedIntervals method passes the raw diff to parseChangedIntervals, whose unquoted `+++ b/` header match omits that file's intervals. verifyReview then uses an empty allowed set for a path the inventory accepts as regular UTF8 text and rejects its credited lines. This is an ordinary minor correctness defect; the smallest compatible fix is to decode quoted pathnames before interval matching.
